recognize_zh: 高倍下小腺管由一層立方上皮圍成清楚管腔，核圓而溫和、無分裂象，外圍可見一層扁平的肌上皮細胞；CK 染色在腺管內層細胞強陽性，周圍間質沒有促纖維增生。
features: Small round to tubular glands lined by a single layer of cuboidal epithelial cells around open central lumina
Bland, uniform round nuclei with fine chromatin, no pleomorphism or mitoses
Attenuated outer layer of flattened (myoepithelial-type) cells surrounding several tubules
Glands arranged in a compact lobule within loose edematous stroma with fat; no desmoplasia
Cytokeratin immunostain (right) strongly positive in the luminal lining cells
describe_en: High-power sections of the edge of a bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E and cytokeratin) show a compact lobule of small tubular glands lined by uniform cuboidal cells with bland round nuclei and open lumina. An attenuated outer layer of flattened cells, consistent with myoepithelium, surrounds several tubules. There is no nuclear pleomorphism, mitotic activity, necrosis or desmoplastic stromal reaction. Cytokeratin strongly highlights the luminal epithelium. Findings are consistent with benign eccrine (sweat gland) ducts carried into the core during the biopsy procedure, not metastatic carcinoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma shows nuclear atypia, prominent nucleoli, mitoses, loss of a myoepithelial layer and desmoplastic stroma, none of which are present.
Breast metastases lack a preserved two-cell (luminal plus myoepithelial) layer and are distributed within the marrow rather than as a lobule at the core edge.
Capillaries are lined by flat endothelial cells that are keratin-negative, whereas these tubules have cuboidal keratin-positive lining cells.
